mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_daily_execution (batch_id, row_key, schedule_date, execution_status, actual_quantity, planned_quantity, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, remark, revision) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{rowKey}, #{scheduleDate}, #{executionStatus}, #{actualQuantity}, #{plannedQuantity}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedAt}, #{remark}, #{revision})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_daily_execution WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND row_key = #{rowKey} AND schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}
SELECT * FROM mrp_daily_execution WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY schedule_date
mapper.sql: SELECT d.batch_id, d.row_key, d.factory_code, d.root_material_code, d.schedule_date, COALESCE(o.manual_quantity, d.system_quantity) effective_quantity FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail d LEFT JOIN mrp_daily_plan_override o ON o.batch_id = #{batchId} AND o.factory_code = d.factory_code AND o.root_material_code = d.root_material_code AND o.terminal_material_code = d.terminal_material_code AND o.terminal_type = d.terminal_type AND o.supply_mode = d.supply_mode AND o.path_group_key = d.path_group_key AND o.schedule_date = d.schedule_date WHERE d.run_id = #{runId} AND d.terminal_type = 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' UNION ALL SELECT d.batch_id, SHA2(CONCAT(d.factory_code, '|', d.root_material_code, '|', d.terminal_material_code, '|', d.terminal_type, '|', d.supply_mode, '|', d.path_group_key, '|', d.source_month, '|', o.schedule_date), 256) row_key, d.factory_code, d.root_material_code, o.schedule_date, o.manual_quantity effective_quantity FROM mrp_daily_plan_override o JOIN mrp_daily_plan_detail d ON d.run_id = #{runId} AND d.factory_code = o.factory_code AND d.root_material_code = o.root_material_code AND d.terminal_material_code = o.terminal_material_code AND d.terminal_type = o.terminal_type AND d.supply_mode = o.supply_mode AND d.path_group_key = o.path_group_key WHERE o.batch_id = #{batchId} AND d.terminal_type = 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' AND d.id = (SELECT t.id FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail t WHERE t.run_id = d.run_id AND t.factory_code = d.factory_code AND t.root_material_code = d.root_material_code AND t.terminal_material_code = d.terminal_material_code AND t.terminal_type = d.terminal_type AND t.supply_mode = d.supply_mode AND t.path_group_key = d.path_group_key ORDER BY t.schedule_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail t WHERE t.run_id = d.run_id AND t.factory_code = d.factory_code AND t.root_material_code = d.root_material_code AND t.terminal_material_code = d.terminal_material_code AND t.terminal_type = d.terminal_type AND t.supply_mode = d.supply_mode AND t.path_group_key = d.path_group_key AND t.schedule_date = o.schedule_date)

where.if: AND (p.root_material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.factory_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, p.batch_id, p.row_key, p.factory_code, p.root_material_code, p.schedule_date, COALESCE(e.execution_status, 'PLANNED') execution_status, COALESCE(e.planned_quantity, p.effective_quantity) planned_quantity, e.actual_quantity, e.confirmed_by, e.confirmed_at, e.remark, e.revision, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM () p LEFT JOIN mrp_daily_execution e ON e.batch_id = p.batch_id AND e.row_key = p.row_key AND e.schedule_date = p.schedule_date
ORDER BY p.schedule_date DESC, p.factory_code, p.root_material_code, p.row_key LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_daily_execution SET execution_status = #{executionStatus}, actual_quantity = #{actualQuantity}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, remark = #{remark}, confirmed_at = NOW(3), revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE mrp_daily_execution SET execution_status = #{executionStatus}, planned_quantity = #{plannedQuantity}, actual_quantity = #{actualQuantity}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, remark = #{remark}, confirmed_at = NOW(3), revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND execution_status = 'PLANNED'
